prompts.name: robot
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite animation sheet for Cricket Android welcome. Reference image is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only, not target sheet layout. Create a BRAND NEW greeting animation with genuinely distinct anatomical poses and limb movements, maintaining exact face, clothing, silhouette, accessories, colors and modern retro JRPG softly outlined pixel art of the reference. Output a square 1024x1024 RGBA PNG on actual transparent background. EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 256x256 cells, 16 sequential frames read left to right then next row. ONE full-body character per cell, same character size, consistent baseline at 230px in every cell, centered at x128. Keep all content inside each cell with generous 12px margins, no crossing cell borders. No grid lines, no numbers, no text, no watermarks, no background, no ground. The animator needs visible progressive pose changes, not duplicate poses. Preserve character anatomy. Mint robot with antenna and yellow chest panel. Frames 1-3 antenna softly lights and eyes open, 4-6 head tilts and right arm rises, 7-12 raised right hand waves twice with changing elbow wrist finger poses, 13-16 arm settles and friendly smile. Keep feet grounded and face dimensions stable. Only this robot, no extra props.
